meta.source: reference/Bora_scenarios_meeting.xlsx (cached values, active case = run 0 = S1 RtB)
meta.units: k€ unless stated; mHUF = HUF million

fx.label: EUR / HUF
fx.note: Single FX for the whole model (also used for mHUF reporting outputs).

cit.label: Hungary corporate income tax
cit.note: Applied to positive cumulative profit at sale, less any gain exempted by the participation exemption (E14).

coc_econ_profit.label: Cost of capital for economic profit
coc_econ_profit.note: Monthly charge on the negative cumulative equity position. Linked to the single discount rate (Inputs row 253 ← Control Panel section c), per decision 02-Oct-26 (Open_Items #10). Previously 8.9% typed.

participation_exemption.label: Participation exemption on RtB share sale (1 = gain on shares exempt)
participation_exemption.note: 1 = the share of distributable proceeds (gain on the SPV/JV shares) is exempt from CIT under the Hungarian participation exemption (bejelentett részesedés): shareholding notified to NAV within 75 days of acquisition and held ≥ 1 year before sale (investment date E27 to sale ≈ 3 years). Interest, 2× top-up and loan returns stay taxable at E12. 0 = flat E12 on all profit at sale.

tender_mw.label: Gross capacity entered in tender
tender_mw.note: Bid-stage items (participation fee, bid bond) scale with this.

conversion_rate.label: Conversion rate (capacity awarded and taken to RTB)
conversion_rate.note: Post-award items and exit proceeds scale with successful capacity.

sale_costs_keur.label: Sale costs at exit
sale_costs_keur.note: Deducted from proceeds in the waterfall.

investment_date.label: Investment date (month 0)
investment_date.note: Start of the monthly grid; every month steps by EOMONTH.

jv_live.label: JV structure live (1 = 70/30 JV, 0 = FEP 100%)
jv_live.note: Master switch. Also drives Assumptions!E8 on the HTM side.

fep_share.label: FEP share of net proceeds if JV

developer_funds_pro_rata.label: Developer funds pro rata (1 = yes)
developer_funds_pro_rata.note: If on, the developer funds its share of both shareholder loans on the same terms.

dsa_keur_per_mw_yr.label: Developer success fee p.a.
dsa_keur_per_mw_yr.note: DSA on installed MW per BORA_Devex – user 09-Oct-26: accrues pro rata to the sale on the installed wind MW (E29, BORA_Devex V37 = 2 500 €/MW × V6); settled at exit from proceeds (not funded to RTB). Cap E37 per the same MW.

r_recoverable.label: Recoverable loan interest (refundable securities)
r_recoverable.note: Compounded monthly on the drawn balance.

min_multiple_at_risk.label: Minimum return on unrecoverable loan
min_multiple_at_risk.note: Top-up paid from proceeds so the at-risk loan returns at least this multiple of principal.

pause_start.label: Interest pause start (no accrual after this date until the pause end, row 73)
pause_start.note: Interest pause 30/06/2029 – 01/01/2030: no accrual in between (user 09-Oct-26)

r_guarantee_interest.label: Interest on bank-guaranteed securities (credited to FEP)
r_guarantee_interest.note: Accrues monthly-compounded on the guarantee-backed securities outstanding; paid to FEP (and Developer pro rata) from sale proceeds, like loan interest.

at_risk_flat_multiple_switch.label: At-risk loan return = flat multiple of principal (1) or 20% compounding with minimum (0)
at_risk_flat_multiple_switch.note: 1 = flat 2× principal in the memo loan schedule (rows 126 / 130); 0 = 20 % compounding topped up to 2×. The waterfall claim (MOIC G131 / G280) always follows BORA_Devex column P: MAX(20 % growth to the exit excl. the pause, 2×) – 2× while the growth is below 2×.

devex_basis_switch.label: Devex basis – retired switch, keep at 1 (BORA Devex line items via Devex_FEP)
devex_basis_switch.note: 1 = devex from the Devex_FEP sheet (BORA_Devex_20260925.xlsx FEP view, updated 29/09/2026). Land reservation fee and land purchase price (Devex rows 14–15) are paid by FEP and earn the 2× at-risk return; their principal is reimbursed by the buyer at RtB exit (not refunded if the project fails) – Devex_FEP J:K, MOIC row 20. RtB land (row 48), financial costs and G&A excluded.

devex_contingency.label: Contingency on FEP-borne devex (line-item basis)
devex_contingency.note: Applied to FEP-borne devex on Devex_FEP. Devex file Y52: €2.65m including contingency.

compounding_effective_switch.label: Interest compounding: annual, BORA Devex convention (1) or monthly (0)
compounding_effective_switch.note: 1 = effective monthly rate (1+r)^(1/12)−1, equivalent to annual compounding as in the Devex file. 0 = nominal r/12.

dsa_start.label: DSA / developer success fee accrual start (signing)
dsa_start.note: Signing 26/10/2026. Fee accrues pro rata (30/360) from here to the sale date at E36, capped at E37.

at_risk_principal_repaid_switch.label: At-risk loan principal (devex) repaid from sale proceeds (1) or carried by FEP (0)
at_risk_principal_repaid_switch.note: 0 = FEP carries its devex (only the 2× return is paid from proceeds), as in the Devex file.

coc_case_b.label: Standard cost of capital on FEP cash-funded items (Case B)
coc_case_b.note: Linked to the model's standard cost of capital (Inputs E13, 8.9%). Opportunity cost on cash FEP funds (cash securities, connection fee, participation fee, devex), compounded to the sale date. Guarantee-backed items use the guarantee fee instead.

pause_end.label: Interest pause end (accrual resumes on this date; user 09-Oct-26)
pause_end.note: Every interest / return accrual (securities 6 % / 12 %, participation fee, devex and land 20 % with the 2× minimum, shareholder-loan and guarantee interest) pauses from row 64 to here, then runs on to the exit date (RtB sale E58; COD sale E155). Not paused: success fee (BORA_Devex X37 = V37), bank guarantee fees. Exact while the pause ends on 1 January (each year keeps one stub); a pause ending mid-year splits that year into two simple stubs – cross-term r²·a·b/365², ≈ +0.8 % on a 20 % line for half a year each side – so a zero-length pause is not exactly the continuous accrual.

bench_wind_mhuf_per_mw.label: Benchmark CAPEX – wind (csatlakozási díj alapdíj)
bench_wind_mhuf_per_mw.note: Wind leg of the %-driven security base. Matches the FEP workbook's 406 mHUF/MW.

bid_bond_rate.label: Bid bond rate (ajánlati biztosíték)
bid_bond_rate.note: 0.5% of the bid-stage base (E91), no uplift – matches BORA Devex I6 (606 mHUF).

supp_security_rate.label: Supplementary security total rate (kiegészítő biztosíték)
supp_security_rate.note: 0 – no supplementary security (kiegészítő biztosíték) in this procedure: GYIK 70 (user 09-Oct-26; removed 07-Oct-26, was 5 %). Deposits rows 13–17 stay at 0; the Bora reconciliation excludes the source's supplementary lines (Deposits E50).

participation_fee_mhuf_per_bid.label: Participation fee (részvételi díj)
participation_fee_mhuf_per_bid.note: Final tender: HUF 3.0m per bid (draft was 2.0m). Source: MEKH kiírás 30-Aug-26 via palyazatok.org, https://palyazatok.org/szeleromu-palyazat/

n_bids.label: Number of separate bids (fee is per bid)
n_bids.note: IC paper: BORA = 6 SPVs (5 × 50 MW + 1 × 30 MW). Case 1 keeps 6 bids at 200 MW as a conservative fee count.

tso_security_mhuf_per_mw.label: Connection request security (igénybejelentési biztosíték)
tso_security_mhuf_per_mw.note: Cash only – the TSO bond cannot be posted as a bank guarantee; credited against the indirect connection fee.

direct_fee_mhuf_per_mw.label: Connection fee – direct (csatlakozási díj – közvetlen)
direct_fee_mhuf_per_mw.note: BORA_Devex_20261002_BG row 19 (unchanged since 25-Sep): direct connection fee 508,345,804 HUF (k€ 1,374 at 370 HUF/EUR in the example); expressed per MW so it scales with capacity. Paid on the connection fee date.

indirect_fee_mhuf_per_mw.label: Connection fee estimate (csatlakozási díj)
indirect_fee_mhuf_per_mw.note: BORA_Devex_20261002_BG row 18: 73,071,306 HUF/MW (unchanged), booked net of the TSO bond. The example applies it to its 260 MW wind capacity (V6; k€ 48,915); the model to the net MVA (Inputs E18) – Bora 200 MVA: k€ 37,573 at 365 HUF/EUR.

bench_bess_mhuf_per_mwh.label: Benchmark CAPEX – BESS
bench_bess_mhuf_per_mwh.note: BESS leg of the %-driven security base.

bid_date.label: Bid submission (pályázat benyújtása)
bid_date.note: Final tender: window 4 Sep – 30 Oct 2026 (draft was 1–18 Sep). Source: MEKH kiírás 30-Aug-26 via Világgazdaság/Portfolio, https://www.portfolio.hu/gazdasag/20260831/meg-csak-most-irtak-ki-a-szeltendert-de-maris-bearnyekolja-a-hazai-szelenergia-celokat-859412

award_date.label: Award (eredményhirdetés)
award_date.note: Final tender: results by 13 Dec 2026 (draft was 2 Dec). Same source as above.

connection_request_date.label: Connection request (igénybejelentés)
connection_request_date.note: Within 15 days of award (linked: award + 14 days).

permit_date.label: Building permit obtained (építési engedély)
permit_date.note: Drives the 50% supplementary refund and the step-down of later instalments.

pb_days_after_award.label: Performance bond payment deadline after award

bid_bond_netting.label: Bid bond credited into performance bond (1 = yes)
bid_bond_netting.note: Only the top-up is a new cash outflow; the bid bond is not released separately.

supp_refund_ratio.label: Supplementary security refund / step-down ratio at building permit

include_after_sale.label: Include instalments falling due after the sale in FEP cash flows (1 = yes)
include_after_sale.note: Default 0: instalments after exit are the buyer's obligation. Set 1 to stress.

failed_bid_bond_refund.label: Bid bond on failed capacity refunded at award (1 = yes)
failed_bid_bond_refund.note: Per tender rules the bid bond is refunded if the bid is unsuccessful.

guarantee_margin.label: Bank guarantee margin (all-in over EURIBOR)
guarantee_margin.note: Reference cost: EURIBOR + 3.00% margin. Used only when E114 = 0.

guarantee_rate.label: Assumed all-in guarantee rate – guarantee-backed securities
guarantee_rate.note: Applied rate for guarantee-backed lines. Overrides EURIBOR + margin when E114 = 1.

guarantee_rate_flat_switch.label: Use assumed all-in rate (1) or EURIBOR + margin (0)
guarantee_rate_flat_switch.note: 1 = cost guarantees at E113 flat; 0 = cost at the selected EURIBOR curve (E112) + E111 margin.

rtb_premium_keur_per_mw.label: RTB exit premium
rtb_premium_keur_per_mw.note: IC paper range 150–250 k€/MW. Final tender (30-Aug-26): a buyer at RTB inherits the municipal one-off commitment (E233, 20 k€/MW) and the annual €/MWh contribution (E234), so treat this premium as gross of those, i.e. net ≈ E141 − E233.

premium_basis_switch.label: RtB premium MW basis (0 = net connection MVA E18 – default, user 06-Oct-26; 1 = installed wind MW E29, as BORA_Devex V34 – user 09-Oct-26)
premium_basis_switch.note: Premium on the net connection MVA (E18) – user decision 06-Oct-26

construction_months.label: Construction duration (NTP → COD)
construction_months.note: Two build seasons; 132 kV connection works (Szombathely OVIT node) on the critical path.

operating_life.label: Operating life
operating_life.note: Measured from COD (partial first and last calendar years). 30 years = grid-connection life constraint; 35 years is the usual wind assumption.

turbine_keur_per_mw.label: Turbine supply incl. transport (6.x MW class)
turbine_keur_per_mw.note: ESTIMATE – base = European turbine 950 k€/MW (user decision 02-Oct-26, ≥80% EU-equipment tender points). IC: all-in ~1,500 k€/MW (Nordex 6.8 MW). Replace with turbine tender quote.

bop_civil.label: Balance of plant – civil (roads, crane pads, drainage)

bop_electrical.label: Balance of plant – electrical (MV cabling, internal grid)

bess_capex_keur_per_mw.label: BESS capex – all-in (capex only: no BESS revenue or opex modelled)
bess_capex_keur_per_mw.note: ESTIMATE. Applied to BESS connection capacity (E20), not wind MW. No contingency applied. The BESS earns nothing in HTM – revenue and opex are not modelled, so HTM returns are understated by whatever the battery would earn.

owners_costs.label: Owner's costs, engineering, PM, construction insurance

land_ntp.label: Land purchase / easements at NTP
land_ntp.note: ESTIMATE. Land is leased; this covers rights-of-way and buy-outs.

p50_hours.label: Net equivalent hours P50 (after wake, availability and electrical losses)
p50_hours.note: IC paper: NCF 28.07%, P50 2,460 h. Already net of losses.

availability_haircut.label: Additional availability / loss haircut
availability_haircut.note: Zero because the hours above are already net.

degradation.label: Annual degradation
degradation.note: ESTIMATE. Compounding from first operating year.

yield_factor.label: Yield sensitivity factor (1.00 = P50)
yield_factor.note: Set to P90/P50 ratio for a P90 case (typically ~0.85–0.88).

price_factor.label: Merchant power price sensitivity factor (1.00 = Aurora curve as selected)
price_factor.note: Scales the Aurora wind capture price used in HTM row 42 (tornado ±10%). Keep at 1.00.

price_source.label: Price source (1 = Aurora curve on Curves, 2 = flat estimate below)
price_source.note: 1 = Aurora Q2 2026 Central (Curves E16) converted to nominal (Curves E19); 2 = flat estimate below (kept for reference / fallback).

est_baseload.label: Estimate: baseload price in first operating year

est_capture_rate.label: Estimate: wind capture rate vs baseload
est_capture_rate.note: ESTIMATE. Hungarian wind cannibalisation is modest at low penetration.

merchant_share.label: Merchant share of output
merchant_share.note: Balance sold under the PPA / CfD below.

ppa_price.label: PPA / CfD strike in first operating year

ppa_tenor.label: PPA / CfD tenor from first operating year

balancing_eur_mwh.label: Balancing / BRP cost
balancing_eur_mwh.note: ESTIMATE. IC flags balancing charges as material.

robin_hood_switch.label: Robin Hood tax (energy suppliers' income tax) applies (1 = yes)
robin_hood_switch.note: FLAG – default 0: each SPV is ≤ 50 MW, so the 31% levy on generators > 50 MW should not bite. Switch on the Control Panel (section c). Confirm with tax adviser.

opex_escalation.label: Opex escalation
opex_escalation.note: ESTIMATE. EUR-denominated, single index (no double indexation).

hipa_pct.label: HIPA local business tax
hipa_pct.note: Base approximated as revenue (conservative – actual base deducts materials and subcontractors).

tax_depreciation_years.label: Tax depreciation period (straight-line from COD)
tax_depreciation_years.note: Hungarian tax rate for power-generation assets to be confirmed.

buyer_discount_rate.label: Discount rate – unlevered project NPV
buyer_discount_rate.note: Linked to the single discount rate (Inputs row 253 ← Control Panel section c), per decision 02-Oct-26 (Open_Items #10). Previously 7% typed.

discount_rate.label: Discount rate for NPV / Equity (all NPV / Equity metrics)
discount_rate.note: Per review 27-Sep-26: 8%, kept as a variable. Drives MOIC G185:G188 and row 229-230, HTM G136:G139, buyer NPV / Equity (HTM G214) and gearing block 15 NPV columns.

net_mva.note: Net grid connection capacity – requested MVA (premium basis, grid fees, TSO bond)

direct_fee_lump_huf.note: Direct connection investment (Annex 1, per connection point); Inputs E84 = E82/1e6/Calc E74

cod.note: COD (Bora N16 -> Calc E91 -> Inputs E298); drives RtB = COD - construction - NTP lag

rtb_sale_date.note: RtB sale date (Bora N17 -> Inputs E28 lag)

bottleneck_loss_rate.note: Generation lost on the overbuilt capacity (Tender E27)

eu_turbine_price_switch.note: EU-turbine promise priced into RtB price (Tender row 213)

bess_value_keur_per_mw.note: BESS value added to the RtB price (Tender E34)

pass_through.note: Pass-through of the promises' PV into the exit price (Calc E89)

pb_hold_months_after_cod.note: Performance security held after COD (buyer guarantee fee in the price effect)

cn_substation_reduction.note: not used on the RtB route

aurora_base_year.note: base year of the real series
